description: This file declares the internal control server classes for the Rialto media server, including factory and control server implementations, with methods for control operations, client registration, and heartbeat handling.

classes.name: ControlServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating control server internal instances.

classes.name: ControlServerInternal
classes.description: Implementation of the control server internal interface, managing control operations, client registration, and heartbeat.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControl instance.

methods.name: createControlServerInternal
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlServerInternal instance with specified id and client.

methods.name: ControlServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control server with main thread factory, id, and client.

methods.name: ~ControlServerInternal
methods.description: Destructor for the control server internal.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a message or command with the given id.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and updates the application state.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Performs a heartbeat check using the provided heartbeat handler.
